name: Gletscher Erlebniswelt Sölden
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Gletscher Erlebniswelt on the Rettenbachferner blends nature, science, and adventure. The 007 ELEMENTS Bond-themed experience area, the interactive glacier exhibition, and the observation deck **"Big 3"** at over 3,000 meters create an unforgettable visit. James Bond enthusiasts will especially enjoy this spot.
